title: 第1章 唯一的男生
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嗯，这是哪里，我明明记得在宿舍里看片……”

秦守迷迷糊糊睁开眼睛。

昏黄斑驳的地铁天花板出现在眼前。

他愣了一下。

什么情况？

这里是一辆老地铁吗？

他为什么会出现在这里？

秦守下意识想撑起身体坐起来。

他刚伸出手。

“唔……”

伴随着旁边传来奇怪的嘤咛声。

秦守的手掌似乎摸到了什么。

入手温润。

手感一级棒！

秦守下意识地捏了捏。

“嗯啊……”

身边奇怪的声音带着颤音儿。

什么声音？

秦守低头望去——

我去啊！

他看到了什么？

地铁车厢内，躺着一个又一个女人。

她们都——没穿衣服啊！

“这里肯定是天堂吧！我果然做好事做得太多，死后飞升天堂了——”

秦守感觉自己的眼睛都看不过来了。

车厢里的九个美女，全都是一等一的绝色。

他的手掌还保持着刚才的姿势，掌心下面是一截纤细的小腿。

目光顺着小腿往上——圆润的膝盖，修长的大腿，再往上——他的视线猛地刹住了车。

苏青青！

大学班上的学习委员，公认的温柔美女苏青青！

目光延伸。

秦守看到了班级里一个又一个熟悉的美女。

体育委员凌云，生活委员叶知秋，美女班长姜瑶……

班长姜瑶半靠着车厢连接处的门上。

脊背即使在昏迷中也挺得笔直。

姜瑶身边是公认的校花林雪儿。

林雪儿同样没穿衣服。

她的长发如墨色丝绸般倾泻而下，披散在她的身下，包裹住她完美的身材……

突然，苏青青的睫毛颤了颤。

她睁开了眼睛。

那双浅褐色的瞳孔还蒙着一层将醒未醒的水雾，迷茫地望着车厢顶部发黄的灯罩，像是在辨认这究竟是什么地方。

然后她的目光缓缓移动，落在了秦守脸上——落在了正低头看着她的秦守脸上。

她眨了眨眼。

低头看了看自己。

看了看秦守搭在她小腿上的那只手。

空气凝固了大约一次呼吸的时间。

Page (1/3)

"Well, where is this? I clearly remember watching movies in the dormitory..."

Qin Shou opened his eyes in a daze.

The dim and mottled subway ceiling appeared in front of me.

He was stunned for a moment.

What's going on?

Is this an old subway?

Why is he here?

Qin Shou subconsciously wanted to prop himself up and sit up.

He just reached out.

"Well..."

There was a strange squeaking sound from the side.

Qin Shou's palm seemed to have touched something.

Start with warmth.

It feels great in hand!

Qin Shou squeezed it subconsciously.

"Yeah..."

The strange sounds around me were vibrating.

What sound?

Qin Shou lowered his head and looked——

Let me go!

What did he see?

In the subway car, women were lying one after another.

They all—have no clothes on!

"This must be heaven! I really did too many good things, and after my death I ascended to heaven——"

Qin Shou felt that his eyes could not see clearly.

The nine beauties in the carriage are all top-notch beauties.

His palms still maintained the same position as before, with a slender calf underneath them.

Looking up his calves—the round knees, the slender thighs, and then up—his eyes suddenly stopped the car.

Su Qingqing!

The study committee member of the university class, the recognized gentle beauty Su Qingqing!

Gaze extended.

Qin Shou saw familiar beauties one after another in the class.

Sports committee member Ling Yun, life committee member Ye Zhiqiu, beautiful monitor Jiang Yao...

Squad leader Jiang Yao was half-leaning against the door connecting the carriages.

Even in coma, his back was straight.

Next to Jiang Yao is Lin Xueer, the recognized school beauty.

Lin Xueer also had no clothes on.

Her long hair cascaded down like ink-colored silk, spreading under her body and wrapping her perfect figure...

Suddenly, Su Qingqing's eyelashes trembled.

She opened her eyes.

The pair of light brown pupils were still covered with a layer of water mist that was about to wake up, and they looked at the yellow lampshade on the top of the carriage confusedly, as if trying to identify where this place was.

Then her eyes moved slowly and fell on Qin Shou's face - on Qin Shou's face who was looking down at her.

She blinked.

He looked down at himself.

She looked at Qin Shou's hand on her calf.

The air froze for about the time of a breath.
